title: Notice
description: Something a person should know while troupe works, such as a wait or a retry, as structured data. It has the same fields as an error; each surface renders it in its own words, and the code identifies it.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable, dotted identifier for this kind of notice, such as run.silent. Surfaces use it to recognise and rephrase the notice.

fix.title: Fix
fix.description: What the person can do about it, if anything.

path.title: Path
path.description: The absolute path of the file or directory concerned, when there is one.

details.title: Details
details.description: Extra structured facts about this notice, keyed by name.
